create_marker_info: create a MarkerInfo instance to track a marker pinned to an articulated link in the scene
update_marker_transform: call update on MarkerInfo to recalculate the current transform from the link node transformation and offset
get_current_position: get the current 3D position of a marker as a numpy array from its updated transform
set_target_joint_state: set the target joint state value for a marker by updating the parent articulated object joint positions
get_target_joint_velocity: get the target joint velocity for a marker from the parent articulated object joint velocities
